description: This Java class, CommonSecret, encapsulates shared secret attributes used across various credential types in the Hono project. It includes properties like enabled status, validity period, and comments, along with getter/setter methods, validation, and utility functions.

classes.name: CommonSecret
classes.description: Abstract class representing common secret properties used within the Hono credential management system, including validity timestamps, enable flag, and comments. Provides fluent API for property setting, validation logic, and string representation.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the secret is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled flag indicating if this secret should be used during authentication. Returns this instance for fluent chaining.

methods.name: getNotBefore
methods.description: Returns the earliest timestamp from when the secret is valid.

methods.name: getNotAfter
methods.description: Returns the latest timestamp until when the secret is valid.

methods.name: setNotBefore
methods.description: Sets the earliest valid timestamp. Returns this instance for fluent chaining.

methods.name: setNotAfter
methods.description: Sets the latest valid timestamp. Returns this instance for fluent chaining.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the human-readable comment describing the secret.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a human-readable comment for the secret. Returns this instance for fluent chaining.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Creates and returns a ToStringHelper object for building a string representation of the secret.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this secret object.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates the secret's timestamps, throwing an exception if 'not-before' is after 'not-after'.
